# Sound library attribution

<!-- Generated by assets/sounds/tools/curate.py from manifest.json. Do not edit. -->

Every clip and picture comes from Wikimedia Commons under a free licence (CC0, public domain, CC BY or CC BY-SA). Clips were trimmed, faded, loudness-normalised and re-encoded to AAC; pictures were downscaled and re-encoded to JPEG. Those adapted versions are offered under the same licence as their source.
